correctness.rationale: Direct substitution at \(m=aq\) gives the exact derivative \(\dot U=x_2^2(q-a-x_2)/(x_2+a)\). Because \(U\) is positive on the nonnegative quadrant and \(\dot U>0\) for \(0<x_2<q-a\), no nonzero nonnegative trajectory can converge to the origin. The Jacobian has a simple zero eigenvalue with positive right eigenvector and one strictly negative eigenvalue; left-right projection gives \(\kappa=A^2(q-a)/(a(A^2+D_1D_2))>0\). These are exact algebraic identities, not numerical extrapolations.

value.rationale: The equality \(m=aq\) is the ecological persistence/extinction boundary. Determining whether positive populations can approach extinction there is mathematically and biologically substantive. The exact weighted drift both excludes threshold extinction for every nonzero nonnegative orbit and identifies the forward-time saddle-node orientation, resolving an internal tension between the source\'s attraction label and its global persistence corollary. This is a structural boundary fact rather than a parameter-only recomputation.
